text: つり　バカ　ポケモン　バカと　さいかい！
note: つりバカ echoes Tsuribaka Nisshi (釣りバカ日誌), a long-running manga and film series about a salaryman obsessed with fishing, so the phrase is instantly familiar to Japanese players.
claim: Tsuribaka Nisshi (釣りバカ日誌) is a long-running Japanese manga and film series about a salaryman obsessed with fishing.

check.quote: The story focuses on salaryman Densuke Hamasaki (a.k.a. Hama-chan), whom his supervisor Sasaki has dubbed the 'Fishing Baka' because of his passion for fishing. ... It has been serialized in Shogakukan's seinen manga magazine Big Comic Original since 1979. ... The franchise had a live-action film series that spanned 20 mainline films released from 1988 to 2009
